items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Well, I watched my mother-in-law and she taught me a few notes

ctx.x: Did your mother help you any? Or did you just watch her and learn?

Well, I watched my mother-in-law and she taught me a few notes and I don't know, somehow I just find myself playing. I used to play many, doing little nickel parties all around the neighborhood and things like that.
Did you have a method when you started or learned to read music or just pick it up?
